nodes.label: Medallion Architecture (Copper -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold)
nodes.rationale: Separate fetch, schema, classification and analysis so parsing/schema bugs are fixed by reprocessing stored raw data instead of re-scraping Wayback or live APIs; primary driver is schema stability for gold.

nodes.label: Copper layer (raw HTTP landing zone)
nodes.rationale: Only layer that touches the network; immutable, idempotent via INSERT OR IGNORE on (url, source_date).

nodes.label: Bronze layer (schema applied)
nodes.rationale: Re-derivable from copper without network so schema changes need no re-scrape.

nodes.label: silver_rejected table
nodes.rationale: Failed validation rows are recorded with a reason, never silently dropped.

nodes.label: Silver upsert key (company, board, job_id, source_date)
nodes.rationale: Same-date rescrape is idempotent while a new source_date adds a row, preserving history for historical analysis.
nodes.norm_label: silver upsert key (company, board, job_id, source_date)

nodes.label: Layer-as-Notebook decision (deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Made bronze/silver/classify notebooks the ETL execution layer via nbconvert and %run classify.ipynb; reversed because it required Jupyter kernels for non-visual ETL, obscured diffs, and made shared logic hard to import/test.

nodes.label: Python-first ETL decision (notebooks gold-only)
nodes.rationale: Keep medallion storage but implement copper/bronze/silver as tested Python modules; Jupyter only needed for optional gold analysis.

nodes.label: No-network end-to-end smoke test contract
nodes.rationale: `python -m pytest -q` passing must mean the app runs: parse URL -> fixture into copper -> bronze -> silver -> summary, without Jupyter or live network.

nodes.label: Python 3.11+ requirement (scipy on macOS 27)
nodes.rationale: Python 3.10's newest scipy ships Fortran binaries the macOS 27 loader rejects, breaking scikit-learn and NLP analysis; scipy 1.16+ needs 3.11+.

nodes.label: Wayback polite fetching (2.5s delay, 5 retries, 5s backoff)
nodes.rationale: Wayback Machine throttles aggressive clients; a shared retrying session with fixed delay avoids bans during historical backfill.
